parse_failure.title: Bin Schedule Parsing Failed
parse_failure.description:
The ABC Council Bin Collection integration was unable to find any valid collection dates on the council website for several consecutive updates.

This usually means the council has changed their website layout or has not yet published the upcoming schedule.

Please check the [GitHub Issue Tracker]({github_url}) to see if an update is available or to report the problem.
